verdict.rationale: Cactus is an inference engine with OpenAI-compatible APIs (gh-2), so assigning a model alias is a fair question for it. However, no evidence documents any way to assign a custom identifier to a loaded model. The only related item is a community critique (comm-18) that models download inline at runtime, and that developers want an API returning an identifier to pass into inference, which suggests the capability is absent.

support.subject: As a developer, I can assign a custom identifier to a loaded model for consistent reference in API calls
